This is a CONTRADICTION relation: the Basin Report's model predicts that exhaustion produces refuted attractors (active but dead), whereas 0e26d6be54fd exemplifies a passive dead zone (no attractor at all). REFUTED IF analysis of the run history shows that 0e26d6be54fd's region did receive conjecture proposals that were all refuted — i.e., if the void is actually a populated basin of refuted conjectures rather than an unsampled dead zone.
